name: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limit
summary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Ltd. (VOEPL) engages in the end-to-end process for electrical components, from initial design and development through to sourcing, manufacturing, and distribution. The company's diverse product lineup includes Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS), air conditioners, storage and instant water heaters, various LED lighting solutions such as lamps, street lights, downlights, and panels, alongside remote controls and complementary accessories. Established on September 11, 2015, the firm is headquartered in Nasik, India.
